authors: Ding, F., Qiu, L. and Chen, T.
title: Reconstruction of continuous-time systems from their non-uniformly sampled discrete-time systems
annotation: Section 5 treats classical multirate reconstruction; Lemma 4 uses intersections of unordered eigenvalue sets. The block-total note instead uses full labeled semigroup matrices and a closed-subgroup argument, without matching eigenvalues.

title: Estimation of Continuous-Time Markov Processes Sampled at Random Time Intervals
annotation: Section 4 distinguishes observed and unobserved sampling times and identifies generators using test functions under its sampling-intensity assumptions. Background for the different independent-clock, block-total protocol; its results are not asserted for arbitrary state-dependent block totals.
